primary.title: EMI late payment charges: Can missing your loan EMI by just one day hurt your credit score? Know what the rules say
primary.summary: Missing a loan EMI by one day can attract late-payment charges, but an immediate credit score drop is not inevitable. Know what RBI rules say about overdue EMIs, credit bureau reporting, penalties and how to protect your credit profile.
